ko.title: 미주리주 판사, 공화당 주도 선거구 획정안에 대한 국민투표 청구 기각… 올 가을 새 선거구 적용 길 열려

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: 콜 카운티 순회법원 판사는 미주리주의 주민 발의 국민투표 절차를 이용해 주에서 새로 획정한 연방 하원 선거구 지도를 저지할 수 없다고 판결했습니다. 이 결정은 11월 중간선거를 앞두고 공화당이 오랜 민주당 우세 지역의 경계를 재획정하는 데 있어 주요 법적 장애물을 제거한 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## 판결의 주요 내용

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: 법원 제출 문서에 따르면, 판사는 올해 초 공화당이 다수당인 주 의회를 통과한 선거구 재획정 법안이 미주리주의 국민투표 절차에 따라 효력이 정지되어 주 전체 투표에 붙여질 수 있는 법률 유형에 해당하지 않는다고 판단했습니다.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: 지도 재획정에 반대하는 이들은 올해 선거 전에 새 경계를 유예하거나 뒤집을 수 있는 주민 투표를 실시하기 위해 서명을 모아왔습니다.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: 국민투표를 통한 저지 경로가 사실상 막히면서, 상급 법원의 개입이 없는 한 재획정된 지도는 2026년 선거 주기에 맞춰 발효될 위치에 놓이게 되었습니다.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: 이번 사건에 참여한 변호사들은 미주리주 대법원에 항소할 가능성이 높다고 밝혀, 화요일 판결로 공화당이 상당한 절차적 승리를 거두었음에도 불구하고 지도 재획정을 둘러싼 싸움은 아직 끝나지 않았음을 시사했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## 논란이 되는 이유

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: 미주리주 공화당원들은 특별 의회 기간 동안 주의 연방 하원 선거구를 재획정했는데, 찬성 측은 이를 인구 변화를 반영하기 위한 일상적인 업데이트라고 설명한 반면, 비판 측은 10년 주기 중간에 이루어진 공격적이고 편파적인 재획정이라고 비난했습니다.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: 새로운 경계선은 현재 민주당 소속인

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: 이매뉴얼 클리버(Emanuel Cleaver) 의원의 지역구인 캔자스시티 기반 제5선거구를 재구성하여, 해당 선거구의 민주당 성향 유권자층 일부를 인접한 공화당 성향이 더 강한 선거구로 이동시켰습니다.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: 2005년부터 이 지역구를 대표해 온 클리버 의원은 새 경계선이 캔자스시티의 흑인 및 민주당 커뮤니티의 표심을 약화시키려는 시도라고 비판했습니다.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: 공화당 입법자들은 10년 주기 중간의 선거구 재획정이 흔치는 않지만 다른 주에서 선례가 없는 것은 아니라고 지적하며, 선거구 경계를 획정하는 의회의 헌법적 권한을 정당하게 행사한 것이라고 지도를 옹호했습니다.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: 미주리주의 이러한 추진은 양당 모두 여러 주에서 주기 중간의 지도 변경을 통해 중간선거를 앞두고 하원 의석을 추가로 확보하려는 전국적인 선거구 재획정 싸움과도 연계되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## 국민투표 싸움

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: 미주리주 헌법은 주최 측이 정해진 기간 내에 충분한 유효 서명을 모을 경우, 유권자들이 표결을 거칠 때까지 신규 법률 시행을 유예하는 주민 대상 국민투표를 청구할 수 있도록 허용하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: 민주당 관계자와 투표권 단체를 포함한 새 연방 하원 지도 반대론자들은 미주리주 주민들이 자신의 선거구가 어떻게 그려지는지에 대해 최종 결정권을 가져야 한다고 주장하며 서명 운동을 시작했습니다.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: 공화당 지도부의 지지를 받는 미주리주는 선거구 재획정 입법이 국민투표 대상이 되는 법률 범주에서 벗어난다고 반박하며, 특정 조치를 이 절차에서 면제하는 미주리주 법률 조항을 가리켰습니다.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: 콜 카운티 판사의 판결은 그 주장에 손을 들어주었으나, 정확한 법적 근거는 항소심에서 면밀한 검토를 받게 될 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: 미주리주의 연방 하원 예비선거 및 후보 등록 마감일이 다가옴에 따라, 항소 시점이 결정적인 변수가 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: 선거 관리자들은 일반적으로 투표지를 인쇄하고 유권자에게 자신이 어느 선거구에 속해 있는지 알리기 위해 예비선거 훨씬 전에 확정된 선거구 경계가 필요하므로, 이의가 제기되면 법원은 지도 분쟁을 신속하게 해결해야 하는 압박에 직면하곤 합니다.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: 이 판결이 유지될 경우 공화당은 가을 중간선거에서 새 경계선을 사용할 수 있게 되며, 무소속 분석가들은 이러한 변화가 공화당 도전자에게 클리버 의원의 의석을 훨씬 더 경합 가능하게 만들 것이라고 말했습니다.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: 민주당과 관련 단체들은 투표지가 확정되기 전에 이전 지도를 복원하거나 주민 투표를 확보하려는 희망으로 긴급 항소를 포함한 법적 대응을 계속 추진할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: 이 사건은 10년 주기 중간 선거구 재획정을 둘러싸고 전국적으로 진행 중인 여러 법적 분쟁 중 하나이며, 그 결과는 2026년 선거를 앞두고 다른 주들이 유사한 지도 변경에 접근하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This is a developing legal story.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 진행 중인 법적 소식입니다.

segments.src: Details may be updated as court proceedings continue.*
segments.tr: 재판 절차가 계속됨에 따라 세부 사항이 업데이트될 수 있습니다.*

zh.title: 密苏里州法官驳回针对共和党划定选区地图的公投挑战，为今年秋季实施新选区界线扫清障碍

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: 密苏里州科尔县巡回法院法官裁定，密苏里州的公民公投程序不能用于阻止该州新划定的国会选区地图。这一裁决消除了共和党人在11月中期选举前重划长期由民主党控制的选区界线的一个重大法律障碍。

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## 裁决内容

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: 根据法庭文件，法官认定共和党控制的立法机构今年早些时候批准的选区重划法，不属于根据密苏里州公投程序可以暂停并进行全州投票的措施类型。

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: 地图的反对者此前一直在收集签名，希望强制进行全民公投，这本可能在今年的选举前推迟或推翻新的选区界线。

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: 随着公投途径目前实际上已被关闭，除非上级法院进行干预，否则重划后的地图有望在2026年选举周期生效。

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: 参与此案的律师表示，很可能会向密苏里州最高法院提起上诉，这意味着尽管周二的裁决为共和党人带来了一场重大的程序性胜利，但围绕该地图的斗争远未结束。

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## 地图为何引发争议

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: 密苏里州共和党人在特别立法会议期间重划了该州的国会选区。支持者称此举是为反映人口变化而进行的常规更新，而批评者则将其定性为激进的、十年中期的党派重划。

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: 新的界线重新配置了以堪萨斯城为中心的第5国会选区，该选区目前由民主党众议员

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: 伊曼纽尔·克利弗（Emanuel Cleaver）把持，通过将该选区内倾向民主党的选民基础部分转移到邻近更倾向共和党的选区中。

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: 自2005年以来一直代表该选区的克利弗称，新的界线是试图稀释堪萨斯城黑人和民主党社区的投票权。

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: 共和党议员为该地图辩护称，这是立法机构行使宪法赋予的划定选区界线权力的合法行为，并指出十年中期的选区重划虽然不常见，但在其他州并非没有先例。

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: 密苏里州的这一举措也与今年在全国范围内上演的更广泛的选区重划之争有关，两党都希望通过在多个州进行周期中期的地图变更，在期中选举前争取更多的众议院席位。

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## 公投之争

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: 密苏里州宪法允许公民就许多新法律请愿进行全民公投，如果组织者在规定时间内收集到足够的有效签名，实际上可以暂停法律的实施，直到选民发表意见。

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: 包括民主党官员和投票权团体在内的新国会地图反对者发起了签名运动，认为密苏里州人应该对如何划定他们的选区拥有最终决定权。

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: 在共和党领导人的支持下，州政府反驳称，选区重划立法不属于符合公投资格的法律类别，并指出密苏里州法律中有条款规定某些措施可豁免于该程序。

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: 科尔县法官的裁决支持了这一论点，尽管确切的法律推理预计在上诉时将面临严格审查。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: 由于密苏里州的国会初选和候选人登记截止日期临近，任何上诉的时间安排都可能具有决定性意义。

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: 选举管理人员通常需要在初选前很早就确定最终的选区界线，以便印制选票并告知选民他们属于哪个选区，这意味着一旦提出挑战，法院往往面临迅速解决地图纠纷的压力。

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: 如果裁决成立，共和党人将能够在秋季中期选举中使用新的界线，独立分析人士称，这一转变将使克利弗的席位对共和党挑战者而言竞争性显著增强。

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: 预计民主党及其盟友团体将继续寻求法律途径，包括可能的紧急上诉，希望在选票最终确定之前恢复旧地图或确保进行全民公投。

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: 此案是全国范围内多起关于十年中期选区重划的法律纠纷之一，其结果可能会影响其他州在2026年选举前如何处理类似的地图变更。

segments.src: *This is a developing legal story.
segments.tr: *这是一个正在发展的法律新闻。

segments.src: Details may be updated as court proceedings continue.*
segments.tr: 随着法庭程序的继续，细节可能会更新。*

hi.title: मिसौरी के न्यायाधीश ने जीओपी-निर्मित मानचित्र के जनमत संग्रह की चुनौती को खारिज किया, इस शरद ऋतु में नए जिला नक्शों का मार्ग प्रशस्त हुआ

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: एक कोल काउंटी सर्किट जज ने फैसला सुनाया है कि मिसौरी की नागरिक जनमत संग्रह प्रक्रिया का उपयोग राज्य के नए बनाए गए कांग्रेस मानचित्र को ब्लॉक करने के लिए नहीं किया जा सकता है, एक ऐसा निर्णय जो नवंबर के मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले लंबे समय से डेमोक्रेटिक गढ़ की सीमाओं को फिर से तैयार करने वाले रिपब्लिकन के लिए एक बड़ी कानूनी बाधा को दूर करता है।

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## फैसले में क्या कहा गया है

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: अदालत के दस्तावेजों के अनुसार, न्यायाधीश ने पाया कि इस साल की शुरुआत में रिपब्लिकन-नियंत्रित विधायिका द्वारा अनुमोदित पुनर्सीमांकन कानून उस प्रकार के माप के रूप में योग्य नहीं है जिसे मिसौरी की जनमत संग्रह प्रक्रिया के तहत निलंबित किया जा सकता है और राज्यव्यापी मतदान के लिए रखा जा सकता है।

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: मानचित्र के विरोधियों ने सार्वजनिक मतदान कराने की उम्मीद में हस्ताक्षर एकत्र किए थे, जिससे इस साल के चुनावों से पहले नए नक्शों में देरी हो सकती थी या उन्हें पलटा जा सकता था।

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: अब जनमत संग्रह का रास्ता प्रभावी रूप से बंद होने के साथ, नया तैयार किया गया मानचित्र 2026 के चुनाव चक्र के लिए प्रभावी होने के लिए तैयार है, जब तक कि कोई उच्च न्यायालय हस्तक्षेप नहीं करता।

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: मामले में शामिल वकीलों ने संकेत दिया है कि मिसौरी सुप्रीम कोर्ट में अपील की संभावना है, जिसका अर्थ है कि मानचित्र को लेकर लड़ाई अभी खत्म नहीं हुई है, भले ही मंगलवार के फैसले ने रिपब्लिकन को एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रक्रियात्मक जीत दिलाई हो।

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## मानचित्र विवादास्पद क्यों है

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: मिसौरी के रिपब्लिकन ने एक विशेष विधायी सत्र के दौरान राज्य के कांग्रेसी जिलों को फिर से तैयार किया, एक ऐसा कदम जिसे समर्थकों ने जनसंख्या परिवर्तनों को दर्शाने के लिए एक नियमित अपडेट के रूप में वर्णित किया और जिसे आलोचकों ने एक आक्रामक, दशक के मध्य के पक्षपाती रीड्रॉ के रूप में चित्रित किया।

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: नई सीमाएं कंसास सिटी-आधारित 5वें कांग्रेसी जिले को पुन: कॉन्फ़िगर करती हैं, जो वर्तमान में डेमोक्रेटिक प्रतिनिधि द्वारा आयोजित है।

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: इमैनुएल क्लीवर, जिले के डेमोक्रेटिक-झुकाव वाले मतदाता आधार के कुछ हिस्सों को पड़ोसी, अधिक रिपब्लिकन-झुकाव वाले जिलों में स्थानांतरित करके।

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: क्लीवर, जो 2005 से जिले का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रहे हैं, ने नई लाइनों को कंसास सिटी के काले और डेमोक्रेटिक समुदायों की मतदान शक्ति को कमजोर करने के प्रयास के रूप में कहा है।

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: रिपब्लिकन कानून निर्माताओं ने जिला सीमाओं को खींचने के लिए विधायिका के संवैधानिक अधिकार के वैध अभ्यास के रूप में मानचित्र का बचाव किया है, यह देखते हुए कि दशक के मध्य का पुनर्सीमांकन, हालांकि असामान्य है, अन्य राज्यों में मिसाल के बिना नहीं है।

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: मिसौरी में धक्का इस साल खेल रहे एक व्यापक राष्ट्रीय पुनर्सीमांकन की लड़ाई से भी जुड़ा हुआ है, क्योंकि दोनों पक्ष कई राज्यों में मध्य-चक्र मानचित्र परिवर्तनों के माध्यम से मध्यावधि से पहले अतिरिक्त सदन सीटों को बाहर करना चाहते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## जनमत संग्रह की लड़ाई

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: मिसौरी का संविधान नागरिकों को कई नए कानूनों पर सार्वजनिक जनमत संग्रह के लिए याचिका दायर करने की अनुमति देता है, जो मतदाताओं के वजन तक कार्यान्वयन को प्रभावी ढंग से रोक देता है, बशर्ते आयोजकों ने एक सेट खिड़की के भीतर पर्याप्त वैध हस्ताक्षर एकत्र किए हों।

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: नए कांग्रेसी मानचित्र के विरोधियों, जिसमें डेमोक्रेटिक अधिकारी और मतदान अधिकार समूह शामिल हैं, ने एक हस्ताक्षर अभियान शुरू किया था जिसमें तर्क दिया गया था कि मिसौरीवासियों को इस बात पर अंतिम अधिकार होना चाहिए कि उनके जिले कैसे खींचे जाते हैं।

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: राज्य, रिपब्लिकन नेताओं द्वारा समर्थित, ने मुकाबला किया कि पुनर्सीमांकन कानून जनमत संग्रह के लिए पात्र कानून की श्रेणियों के बाहर आता है, मिसौरी कानून में प्रावधानों की ओर इशारा करते हुए जो प्रक्रिया से कुछ उपायों को छूट देते हैं।

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: कोल काउंटी जज के फैसले ने उस तर्क का पक्ष लिया, हालांकि सटीक कानूनी तर्क की अपील पर करीब से जांच का सामना करने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होता है

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: क्योंकि मिसौरी का कांग्रेसी प्राथमिक और फाइलिंग समय सीमा नजदीक आ रही है, इसलिए किसी भी अपील का समय निर्णायक साबित हो सकता है।

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: चुनाव प्रशासकों को आमतौर पर मतपत्रों को प्रिंट करने और मतदाताओं को यह सूचित करने के लिए प्राथमिक से बहुत पहले अंतिम रूप से तैयार जिला लाइनों की आवश्यकता होती है कि वे किस जिले से संबंधित हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि एक बार चुनौती दायर होने के बाद अदालतों को अक्सर नक्शे के विवादों को जल्दी से हल करने के लिए दबाव का सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: यदि फैसला खड़ा रहता है, तो रिपब्लिकन पतन मध्यावधि में नई लाइनों का उपयोग करने के लिए तैनात होंगे, एक बदलाव जो स्वतंत्र विश्लेषकों ने कहा है कि क्लीवर की सीट को जीओपी चैलेंजर के लिए काफी अधिक प्रतिस्पर्धी बना देगा।

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: डेमोक्रेट्स और संबद्ध समूहों से कानूनी विकल्पों को आगे बढ़ाना जारी रखने की उम्मीद है, जिसमें एक संभावित आपातकालीन अपील शामिल है, पुराने मानचित्र को बहाल करने की उम्मीद में या मतपत्रों को अंतिम रूप देने से पहले सार्वजनिक वोट सुरक्षित करने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: यह मामला दशक के मध्य के पुनर्सीमांकन पर देश भर में चल रहे कई कानूनी विवादों में से एक है, और इसका परिणाम यह प्रभावित कर सकता है कि अन्य राज्य 2026 के चुनावों की दौड़ में इसी तरह के मानचित्र परिवर्तनों से कैसे संपर्क करते हैं।

segments.src: *This is a developing legal story.
segments.tr: *यह एक विकसित कानूनी कहानी है।

segments.src: Details may be updated as court proceedings continue.*
segments.tr: अदालत की कार्यवाही जारी रहने पर विवरण अद्यतन किया जा सकता है।*

es.title: Juez de Misuri rechaza el desafío por referéndum al mapa diseñado por los republicanos, despejando el camino para los nuevos límites distritales este otoño

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Un juez de circuito del condado de Cole ha dictaminado que el proceso de referéndum ciudadano de Misuri no puede utilizarse para bloquear el mapa congresional recién diseñado del estado, una decisión que elimina un importante obstáculo legal para que los republicanos rediseñen los límites de un baluarte demócrata de larga data antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre.

segments.tr: ## Lo que dice el fallo

segments.tr: Según los documentos judiciales, el juez determinó que la ley de redistribución de distritos aprobada por la legislatura controlada por los republicanos a principios de este año no califica como el tipo de medida que puede suspenderse y someterse a una votación estatal bajo el proceso de referéndum de Misuri.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: Con la vía del referéndum efectivamente cerrada por ahora, el mapa rediseñado está posicionado para entrar en vigor para el ciclo electoral de 2026, a menos que un tribunal superior intervenga.

segments.tr: Los abogados involucrados en el caso han indicado que es probable que se presente una apelación ante la Corte Suprema de Misuri, lo que significa que la lucha por el mapa está lejos de terminar, aunque el fallo del martes otorgue a los republicanos una victoria procesal significativa.

ar.title: قاضٍ في ميزوري يرفض الطعن في الاستفتاء على الخريطة التي رسمها الجمهوريون، مما يمهد الطريق لخطوط دوائر جديدة هذا الخريف

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: قضى قاضي دائرة في مقاطعة كول بأن عملية الاستفتاء الشعبي في ميزوري لا يمكن استخدامها لعرقلة خريطة الكونغرس التي رسمتها الولاية حديثاً، وهو قرار يزيل عقبة قانونية رئيسية أمام الجمهوريين لإعادة رسم حدود معقل ديمقراطي طويل الأمد قبل انتخابات التجديد النصفي في نوفمبر.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## ما الذي ينص عليه الحكم

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: وفقاً لملفات المحكمة، وجد القاضي أن قانون إعادة تقسيم الدوائر الذي وافقت عليه الهيئة التشريعية التي يسيطر عليها الجمهوريون في وقت سابق من هذا العام لا يصنف كنوع من الإجراءات التي يمكن تعليقها وطرحها للتصويت على مستوى الولاية بموجب عملية الاستفتاء في ميزوري.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: كان معارضو الخريطة يجمعون التوقيعات على أمل فرض تصويت عام كان من الممكن أن يؤدي إلى تأخير أو إلغاء الخطوط الجديدة قبل انتخابات هذا العام.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: مع إغلاق مسار الاستفتاء فعلياً في الوقت الحالي، أصبحت الخريطة المعاد رسمها مهيأة لدخول حيز التنفيذ لدورة انتخابات 2026، ما لم تتدخل محكمة أعلى.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: أشار المحامون المشاركون في القضية إلى أن الاستئناف أمام المحكمة العليا في ميزوري مرجح، مما يعني أن المعركة حول الخريطة لم تنته بعد، حتى مع منح حكم الثلاثاء للجمهوريين فوزاً إجرائياً مهماً.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## لماذا تعتبر الخريطة مثيرة للجدل

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: قام الجمهوريون في ميزوري بإعادة رسم دوائر الكونغرس في الولاية خلال جلسة تشريعية خاصة، وهي خطوة وصفها المؤيدون بأنها تحديث روتيني ليعكس التغيرات السكانية، ووصفها النقاد بأنها إعادة رسم حزبية عدوانية في منتصف العقد.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: تعيد الحدود الجديدة تشكيل الدائرة الخامسة للكونغرس ومقرها كانساس سيتي، والتي يشغلها حالياً النائب الديمقراطي

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: إيمانويل كليفر، من خلال نقل أجزاء من القاعدة الانتخابية المائلة للديمقراطيين في الدائرة إلى دوائر مجاورة أكثر ميلاً للجمهوريين.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: وصف كليفر، الذي يمثل الدائرة منذ عام 2005، الخطوط الجديدة بأنها محاولة لتخفيف القوة التصويتية لمجتمعات السود والديمقراطيين في كانساس سيتي.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: دافع المشرعون الجمهوريون عن الخريطة باعتبارها ممارسة مشروعة لسلطة الهيئة التشريعية الدستورية لرسم حدود الدوائر، مشيرين إلى أن إعادة تقسيم الدوائر في منتصف العقد، رغم أنها غير معتادة، ليست بدون سابقة في ولايات أخرى.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: كما ارتبطت هذه الخطوة في ميزوري بمعركة أوسع لإعادة تقسيم الدوائر على المستوى الوطني تدور أحداثها هذا العام، حيث يتطلع كلا الحزبين إلى انتزاع مقاعد إضافية في مجلس النواب قبل انتخابات التجديد النصفي من خلال تغييرات في الخرائط في منتصف الدورة في عدة ولايات.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## معركة الاستفتاء

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: يسمح دستور ميزوري للمواطنين بتقديم التماس لإجراء استفتاء عام على العديد من القوانين الجديدة، مما يؤدي فعلياً إلى إيقاف التنفيذ مؤقتاً حتى يدلي الناخبون بأصواتهم، بشرط أن يجمع المنظمون عدداً كافياً من التوقيعات الصحيحة خلال فترة زمنية محددة.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: كان معارضو خريطة الكونغرس الجديدة، بما في ذلك المسؤولون الديمقراطيون وجماعات حقوق التصويت، قد أطلقوا حملة لجمع التوقيعات بحجة أن سكان ميزوري يجب أن يكون لهم القول الفصل في كيفية رسم دوائرهم.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: ردت الولاية، بدعم من القادة الجمهوريين، بأن تشريعات إعادة تقسيم الدوائر تقع خارج فئات القوانين المؤهلة للاستفتاء، مشيرة إلى أحكام في قانون ميزوري تعفي إجراءات معينة من هذه العملية.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: انحاز حكم قاضي مقاطعة كول إلى تلك الحجة، على الرغم من أنه من المتوقع أن يواجه التفكير القانوني الدقيق تدقيقاً وثيقاً عند الاستئناف.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: نظراً لاقتراب المواعيد النهائية للانتخابات التمهيدية للكونغرس في ميزوري ومواعيد تقديم الطلبات، قد يكون توقيت أي استئناف حاسماً.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: يحتاج مسؤولو الانتخابات عموماً إلى خطوط دوائر نهائية قبل وقت طويل من الانتخابات التمهيدية لطباعة بطاقات الاقتراع وإبلاغ الناخبين بالدائرة التي ينتمون إليها، مما يعني أن المحاكم غالباً ما تواجه ضغوطاً لحل نزاعات الخرائط بسرعة بمجرد تقديم الطعن.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: إذا صمد الحكم، فسيكون الجمهوريون في وضع يسمح لهم باستخدام الخطوط الجديدة في انتخابات التجديد النصفي في الخريف، وهو تحول قال محللون مستقلون إنه سيجعل مقعد كليفر أكثر تنافسية بشكل ملحوظ بالنسبة لمنافس جمهوري.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: من المتوقع أن يواصل الديمقراطيون والجماعات المتحالفة معهم متابعة الخيارات القانونية، بما في ذلك استئناف طارئ محتمل، على أمل استعادة الخريطة القديمة أو تأمين تصويت عام قبل الانتهاء من بطاقات الاقتراع.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: تعد هذه القضية واحدة من عدة نزاعات قانونية جارية على مستوى البلاد حول إعادة تقسيم الدوائر في منتصف العقد، وقد تؤثر نتيجتها على كيفية تعامل الولايات الأخرى مع تغييرات مماثلة في الخرائط في الفترة التي تسبق انتخابات 2026.

segments.tr: *هذه قصة قانونية قيد التطور.

segments.src: Details may be updated as court proceedings continue.*

fr.title: Un juge du Missouri rejette la contestation du référendum sur la carte tracée par les républicains, ouvrant la voie à de nouvelles lignes de district cet automne

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Un juge de circuit du comté de Cole a statué que le processus de référendum citoyen du Missouri ne peut pas être utilisé pour bloquer la nouvelle carte congressionnelle de l'État, une décision qui élimine un obstacle juridique majeur aux efforts des républicains pour redessiner les limites d'un bastion démocrate de longue date avant les élections de mi-mandat de novembre.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## Ce que dit la décision

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: Selon les documents judiciaires, le juge a estimé que la loi sur le redécoupage électoral approuvée au début de cette année par l'assemblée législative contrôlée par les républicains ne correspond pas au type de mesure qui peut être suspendue et soumise à un vote à l'échelle de l'État dans le cadre du processus référendaire du Missouri.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: Les opposants à la carte avaient recueilli des signatures dans l'espoir de forcer un vote public qui aurait pu retarder ou annuler les nouvelles lignes avant les élections de cette année.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: La voie référendaire étant désormais effectivement fermée, la carte redessinée est en position d'entrer en vigueur pour le cycle électoral de 2026, à moins qu'une juridiction supérieure n'intervienne.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: Les avocats impliqués dans l'affaire ont indiqué qu'un appel devant la Cour suprême du Missouri est probable, ce qui signifie que la bataille autour de la carte est loin d'être terminée, même si la décision de mardi constitue une victoire procédurale significative pour les républicains.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la carte est controversée

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: Les républicains du Missouri ont redessiné les districts congressionnels de l'État lors d'une session législative extraordinaire, une mesure que les partisans ont décrite comme une mise à jour de routine pour refléter les changements démographiques et que les critiques ont qualifiée d'agressif redécoupage partisan en milieu de décennie.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: Les nouvelles limites reconfigurent le 5e district congressionnel basé à Kansas City, actuellement détenu par le représentant démocrate

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver, en déplaçant des portions de la base électorale du district favorable aux démocrates vers des districts voisins plus favorables aux républicains.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: Cleaver, qui représente le district depuis 2005, a qualifié les nouvelles lignes de tentative visant à diluer le pouvoir de vote des communautés noires et démocrates de Kansas City.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: Les législateurs républicains ont défendu la carte comme un exercice légitime de l'autorité constitutionnelle de l'assemblée législative pour tracer les limites des districts, soulignant que le redécoupage en milieu de décennie, bien qu'inhabituel, n'est pas sans précédent dans d'autres états.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: L'initiative dans le Missouri a également été liée à une bataille nationale plus large sur le redécoupage électoral qui se déroule cette année, les deux partis cherchant à obtenir des sièges supplémentaires à la Chambre avant les élections de mi-mandat grâce à des modifications de cartes en milieu de cycle dans plusieurs États.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## La bataille référendaire

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: La constitution du Missouri permet aux citoyens de faire une pétition pour un référendum public sur de nombreuses nouvelles lois, suspendant de fait la mise en œuvre jusqu'à ce que les électeurs se prononcent, à condition que les organisateurs recueillent suffisamment de signatures valides dans un délai déterminé.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: Les opposants à la nouvelle carte congressionnelle, y compris des responsables démocrates et des groupes de défense des droits de vote, avaient lancé une campagne de signatures arguant que les habitants du Missouri devraient avoir le dernier mot sur la façon dont leurs districts sont tracés.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: L'État, soutenu par les dirigeants républicains, a rétorqué que la législation sur le redécoupage se situe en dehors des catégories de lois éligibles au référendum, en soulignant les dispositions de la loi du Missouri qui exemptent certaines mesures du processus.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: La décision du juge du comté de Cole s'est rangée de l'avis de cet argument, bien que le raisonnement juridique exact doive faire l'objet d'un examen minutieux en appel.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il ensuite

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: Les élections primaires et les dates limites de dépôt des candidatures au Congrès du Missouri approchant, le calendrier de tout appel pourrait s'avérer décisif.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: Les administrateurs électoraux ont généralement besoin de lignes de district finalisées bien avant une primaire pour imprimer les bulletins de vote et informer les électeurs du district auquel ils appartiennent, ce qui signifie que les tribunaux subissent souvent des pressions pour résoudre rapidement les litiges liés aux cartes une fois qu'un recours est déposé.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: Si la décision est maintenue, les républicains seraient en mesure d'utiliser les nouvelles lignes lors des élections de mi-mandat d'automne, un changement qui, selon des analystes indépendants, rendrait le siège de Cleaver nettement plus compétitif pour un adversaire républicain.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: Les démocrates et les groupes alliés devraient continuer à explorer les options juridiques, y compris un éventuel appel d'urgence, dans l'espoir de rétablir l'ancienne carte ou d'obtenir un vote public avant la finalisation des bulletins de vote.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: Cette affaire est l'un des nombreux litiges juridiques en cours à travers le pays concernant le redécoupage électoral en milieu de décennie, et son issue pourrait influencer la façon dont d'autres États abordent des changements de cartes similaires à l'approche des élections de 2026.

segments.tr: ## A Luta do Referendo

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: A constituição do Missouri permite que os cidadãos peçam por um referendo público sobre muitas novas leis, pausando efetivamente a implementação até que os eleitores se pronunciem, desde que os organizadores reúnam assinaturas válidas suficientes dentro de um prazo estabelecido.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: Oponentes do novo mapa congressional, incluindo autoridades democratas e grupos de direitos de voto, haviam lançado uma campanha de assinaturas argumentando que os habitantes do Missouri deveriam ter a palavra final sobre como seus distritos são desenhados.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: O estado, apoiado por líderes republicanos, retrucou que a legislação de redistritamento fica fora das categorias de lei elegíveis para referendo, apontando para disposições na lei do Missouri que isentam certas medidas do processo.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: A decisão do juiz do Condado de Cole ficou do lado desse argumento, embora o raciocínio jurídico exato deva enfrentar escrutínio rigoroso em recurso.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Acontece a Seguir

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: Como as primárias congressuais e os prazos de registro do Missouri estão se aproximando, o momento de qualquer recurso pode se mostrar decisivo.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: Os administradores eleitorais geralmente precisam de linhas de distrito finalizadas bem antes de uma primária para imprimir cédulas e informar aos eleitores a qual distrito eles pertencem, o que significa que os tribunais frequentemente enfrentam pressão para resolver disputas de mapas rapidamente assim que um desafio é apresentado.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: Se a decisão se mantiver, os republicanos estariam posicionados para usar as novas linhas nas eleições de meio de mandato de outono, uma mudança que analistas independentes disseram que tornaria a cadeira de Cleaver significativamente mais competitiva para um desafiante do GOP.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: Espera-se que os democratas e grupos aliados continuem buscando opções legais, incluindo um possível recurso de emergência, na esperança de restaurar o mapa mais antigo ou garantir uma votação pública antes que as cédulas sejam finalizadas.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: O caso é uma das várias disputas legais em andamento em todo o país sobre o redistritamento no meio da década, e seu resultado pode influenciar como outros estados abordam mudanças de mapas semelhantes na preparação para as eleições de 2026.

in.title: Hakim Missouri Menolak Tantangan Referendum terhadap Peta Rancangan GOP, Membuka Jalan bagi Batas Wilayah Baru Musim Gugur Ini

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Seorang hakim sirkuit Cole County telah memutuskan bahwa proses referendum warga Missouri tidak dapat digunakan untuk memblokir peta kongres negara bagian yang baru dirancang, sebuah keputusan yang menghapus hambatan hukum utama bagi Partai Republik untuk merancang ulang batas-batas wilayah kekuasaan Demokrat yang sudah lama berdiri jelang pemilu sela November.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## Apa Isi Putusan Tersebut

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: Menurut berkas pengadilan, hakim menemukan bahwa undang-undang redistriksi yang disetujui oleh legislatur yang dikuasai Partai Republik awal tahun ini tidak memenuhi syarat sebagai jenis tindakan yang dapat ditangguhkan dan dipungut suara secara luas di tingkat negara bagian di bawah proses referendum Missouri.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: Penentang peta tersebut telah mengumpulkan tanda tangan dengan harapan memaksakan pemungutan suara publik yang dapat menunda atau membatalkan garis-garis baru sebelum pemilu tahun ini.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: Dengan jalur referendum yang secara efektif tertutup untuk saat ini, peta yang dirancang ulang tersebut diposisikan untuk mulai berlaku pada siklus pemilu 2026, kecuali jika pengadilan yang lebih tinggi turun tangan.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: Pengacara yang terlibat dalam kasus ini telah mengindikasikan bahwa banding ke Mahkamah Agung Missouri kemungkinan besar akan dilakukan, yang berarti perebutan peta tersebut masih jauh dari selesai meskipun putusan hari Selasa memberikan kemenangan prosedural yang signifikan bagi Partai Republik.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Peta Ini Kontroversial

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: Partai Republik Missouri merancang ulang distrik kongres negara bagian selama sesi legislatif khusus, sebuah langkah yang digambarkan oleh para pendukung sebagai pembaruan rutin untuk mencerminkan perubahan populasi dan dikarakterisasikan oleh para kritikus sebagai perancangan ulang partisan pertengahan dekade yang agresif.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: Batas-batas baru tersebut mengonfigurasi ulang Distrik Kongres ke-5 yang berbasis di Kansas City, yang saat ini dipegang oleh Anggota DPR dari Partai Demokrat

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver, dengan memindahkan sebagian dari basis pemilih distrik yang cenderung Demokrat ke distrik-distrik tetangga yang lebih cenderung memilih Republik.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: Cleaver, yang telah mewakili distrik tersebut sejak 2005, menyebut garis-garis baru itu sebagai upaya untuk mencairkan kekuatan suara komunitas kulit hitam dan Demokrat di Kansas City.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: Anggota parlemen dari Partai Republik membela peta tersebut sebagai pelaksanaan sah atas kewenangan konstitusional legislatur untuk menarik batas distrik, dengan mencatat bahwa redistriksi pertengahan dekade, meskipun tidak biasa, bukan tanpa preseden di negara bagian lain.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: Pendorongan di Missouri ini juga dikaitkan dengan pertempuran redistriksi nasional yang lebih luas yang terjadi tahun ini, karena kedua partai berusaha mendesak kursi DPR tambahan menjelang pemilu sela melalui perubahan peta pertengahan siklus di beberapa negara bagian.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## Pertempuran Referendum

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: Konstitusi Missouri mengizinkan warga negara untuk mengajukan petisi untuk referendum publik atas banyak undang-undang baru, secara efektif menunda implementasi sampai pemilih memberikan suara, asalkan penyelenggara mengumpulkan cukup banyak tanda tangan yang sah dalam jangka waktu tertentu.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: Penentang peta kongres baru, termasuk pejabat Demokrat dan kelompok hak-hak pemungutan suara, telah meluncurkan pengumpulan tanda tangan dengan argumen bahwa warga Missouri harus memiliki kata akhir tentang bagaimana distrik mereka digambar.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: Negara bagian, yang didukung oleh para pemimpin Republik, membalas bahwa perundang-undangan redistriksi berada di luar kategori undang-undang yang memenuhi syarat untuk referendum, menunjuk pada ketentuan dalam hukum Missouri yang membebaskan tindakan tertentu dari proses tersebut.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: Putusan hakim Cole County berpihak pada argumen itu, meskipun penalaran hukum yang tepat diperkirakan akan menghadapi pemeriksaan ketat saat banding.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: Karena batas waktu pendaftaran dan pemilihan primer kongres Missouri makin dekat, penetapan waktu banding apa pun dapat terbukti menentukan.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: Administrator pemilihan umumnya membutuhkan garis distrik yang telah difinalisasi jauh sebelum pemilihan primer untuk mencetak surat suara dan memberi tahu pemilih masuk ke distrik mana mereka, yang berarti pengadilan sering menghadapi tekanan untuk menyelesaikan sengketa peta dengan cepat setelah tantangan diajukan.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: Jika putusan tetap bertahan, Partai Republik akan berada dalam posisi untuk menggunakan garis-garis baru pada pemilu sela musim gugur, sebuah pergeseran yang menurut analis independen akan membuat kursi Cleaver jauh lebih kompetitif bagi penantang GOP.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: Partai Demokrat dan kelompok sekutu diperkirakan akan terus mengejar opsi hukum, termasuk kemungkinan banding darurat, dengan harapan memulihkan peta lama atau mengamankan pemungutan suara publik sebelum surat suara difinalisasi.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: Kasus ini adalah salah satu dari beberapa sengketa hukum yang sedang berlangsung di seluruh negeri terkait redistriksi pertengahan dekade, dan hasilnya dapat memengaruhi bagaimana negara bagian lain mendekati perubahan peta serupa jelang pemilu 2026.

ja.title: ミズーリ州判事、共和党主導の選挙区地図に対する住民投票の異議申し立てを却下、今秋の新たな選挙区境界線への道を開く

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: ミズーリ州コール郡の巡回裁判所判事は、ミズーリ州の市民による住民投票プロセスを用いて、州が新たに策定した連邦議会の選挙区地図を阻止することはできないとの判決を下した。この決定により、11月の中間選挙を前に、長年民主党の牙城であった地域の境界線を共和党が引き直すことに対する大きな法的障害が取り除かれた。

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## 判決の内容

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: 裁判所に提出された書類によると、判事は、今年初めに共和党が支配する議会によって承認された選挙区再編法は、ミズーリ州の住民投票プロセスに基づいて一時停止し、州全体の投票に付すことができる種類の措置には該当しないと判断した。

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: 選挙区地図の反対派は、今年の選挙前に新しい境界線を遅らせるか覆す可能性のある公的投票を強制することを期待して署名を集めていた。

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: 住民投票という手段が当面事実上閉ざされたことで、上級裁判所が介入しない限り、再編された地図は2026年の選挙サイクルから適用される見通しとなった。

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: この訴訟に関与する弁護士らは、ミズーリ州最高裁判所への上訴が行われる可能性が高いと示唆しており、火曜日の判決は共和党に重要な手続き上の勝利をもたらしたものの、選挙区地図をめぐる争いはまだ終わっていないことを意味している。

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## なぜこの地図が物議を醸しているのか

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: ミズーリ州の共和党は、特別議会中に州の連邦議会選挙区を再編した。この動きについて、支持者は人口の変化を反映させるための日常的な更新であると説明し、批判者は10年の中間に行われる攻撃的で党派的な再編であると特徴づけた。

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: 新しい境界線は、現在民主党のエマニュエル・クリーバー下院議員が保持しているカンザスシティを拠点とする第5選挙区を再構成するもので、

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: 同選挙区の民主党寄りの有権者基盤の一部を、近隣のより共和党寄りの選挙区に移すものである。

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: 2005年から同選挙区選出のクリーバー議員は、新しい境界線について、カンザスシティの黒人コミュニティや民主党支持者の投票力を希薄化させる試みであると批判している。

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: 共和党議員らは、選挙区の境界線を引くという議会の憲法上の権限を正当に行使したものであると地図を擁護し、10年の中間に行う選挙区再編は異例ではあるものの、他州でも前例がないわけではないと指摘している。

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: ミズーリ州でのこの動きは、今年展開されているより広範な全米規模の選挙区再編の戦いとも関連しており、両党とも中間選挙を前に、いくつかの州で中間サイクルの地図変更を通じて下院議席をさらに確保しようとしている。

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## 住民投票をめぐる争い

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: ミズーリ州憲法は、市民が多くの新しい法律に対して住民投票を請願することを認めており、主催者が定められた期間内に十分な有効署名を集めれば、有権者が判断を下すまで事実上その施行を一時停止させることができる。

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: 民主党の当局者や投票権団体を含む新しい連邦議会選挙区地図の反対派は、選挙区がどのように描かれるかについてミズーリ州民が最終決定権を持つべきだと主張し、署名活動を開始していた。

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: 共和党指導部に支えられた州側は、選挙区再編法は住民投票の対象となる法律のカテゴリーには含まれないと反論し、ミズーリ州法において特定の措置をこのプロセスから除外する規定があることを指摘した。

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: コール郡の判事の判決はその主張を支持したが、正確な法的根拠については上訴審で精査される見通しである。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展開

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: ミズーリ州の連邦議会予備選挙と立候補締め切りが迫っているため、上訴のタイミングが決定的な要因となる可能性がある。

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: 選挙管理者は通常、投票用紙を印刷し、有権者にどの選挙区に属しているかを知らせるために、予備選挙のかなり前に確定した選挙区境界線を必要とする。つまり、異議申し立てがなされると、裁判所は迅速に地図紛争を解決するよう圧力を受けることが多い。

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: もしこの判決が維持されれば、共和党は秋の中間選挙で新しい境界線を使用できる立場となり、独立系アナリストらは、これがクリーバー議員の議席を共和党の挑戦者にとって大幅に競争力のあるものにすると述べている。

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: 民主党とその関連団体は、古い地図を復活させるか、投票用紙が確定する前に公的投票を確保することを期待して、緊急上訴の可能性を含め、法的選択肢を追求し続けると見られている。

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: この訴訟は、全米で進行中の10年の中間に行われる選挙区再編をめぐるいくつかの法的紛争の一つであり、その結果は、2026年の選挙に向けて他州が同様の地図変更にどのように取り組むかに影響を与える可能性がある。

segments.tr: Da der Weg über ein Referendum vorerst effektiv versperrt ist, wird die neu gezogene Karte voraussichtlich für den Wahlzyklus 2026 in Kraft treten, es sei denn, ein höheres Gericht greift ein.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: An dem Fall beteiligte Anwälte haben signalisiert, dass eine Berufung beim Obersten Gerichtshof von Missouri wahrscheinlich ist, was bedeutet, dass der Streit um die Karte noch lange nicht vorbei ist, auch wenn das Urteil vom Dienstag den Republikanern einen bedeutenden verfahrenstechnischen Sieg beschert.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## Warum die Karte umstritten ist

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: Die Republikaner in Missouri haben die Kongresswahlbezirke des Staates während einer Sondersitzung des Parlaments neu gezeichnet – ein Schritt, den Befürworter als routinemäßige Aktualisierung zur Widerspiegelung von Bevölkerungsveränderungen und Kritiker als aggressive, parteiische Neugestaltung mitten im Jahrzehnt bezeichneten.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: Die neuen Grenzen konfigurieren den in Kansas City ansässigen 5. Kongresswahlbezirk, der derzeit vom demokratischen Abgeordneten

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver gehalten wird, neu, indem sie Teile der demokratisch orientierten Wählerschaft des Bezirks in benachbarte, stärker republikanisch orientierte Bezirke verschieben.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: Cleaver, der den Bezirk seit 2005 vertritt, hat die neuen Grenzen als Versuch bezeichnet, die Stimmkraft der schwarzen und demokratischen Gemeinschaften in Kansas City zu verwässern.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: Republikanische Gesetzgeber haben die Karte als legitime Ausübung der verfassungsmäßigen Befugnis des Parlaments zur Festlegung von Wahlkreisgrenzen verteidigt und darauf hingewiesen, dass eine Neugestaltung der Wahlkreise mitten im Jahrzehnt zwar ungewöhnlich, in anderen Staaten jedoch nicht ohne Präzedenzfall ist.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: Der Vorstoß in Missouri steht zudem im Zusammenhang mit einem größeren nationalen Streit um die Neugestaltung der Wahlkreise, der in diesem Jahr ausgetragen wird, da beide Parteien versuchen, sich vor den Zwischenwahlen durch Änderungen der Karten mitten im Zyklus in mehreren Staaten zusätzliche Sitze im Repräsentantenhaus zu sichern.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## Der Kampf um das Referendum

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: Die Verfassung von Missouri erlaubt es den Bürgern, eine Petition für ein öffentliches Referendum zu vielen neuen Gesetzen einzureichen, wodurch die Umsetzung faktisch pausiert wird, bis die Wähler ihre Stimme abgeben, vorausgesetzt, die Organisatoren sammeln innerhalb eines festgelegten Zeitfensters genügend gültige Unterschriften.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: Gegner der neuen Kongresskarte, darunter demokratische Beamte und Gruppen für Wahlrechte, hatten eine Unterschriftenkampagne gestartet mit dem Argument, dass die Bürger von Missouri das letzte Wort darüber haben sollten, wie ihre Wahlkreise gezeichnet werden.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: Der Staat, unterstützt von republikanischen Führern, hielt dagegen, dass die Gesetzgebung zur Neugestaltung der Wahlkreise außerhalb der Kategorien von Gesetzen liegt, die für ein Referendum in Frage kommen, und verwies auf Bestimmungen im Recht von Missouri, die bestimmte Maßnahmen von dem Prozess ausnehmen.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: Das Urteil des Richters aus dem Cole County schloss sich diesem Argument an, auch wenn erwartet wird, dass die genaue juristische Begründung bei einer Berufung einer genauen Prüfung unterzogen wird.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: Da die Vorwahlen und Einreichungsfristen für den Kongress in Missouri näher rücken, könnte sich der Zeitpunkt einer Berufung als entscheidend erweisen.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: Wahlleiter benötigen im Allgemeinen lange vor einer Vorwahl fertiggestellte Wahlkreisgrenzen, um Stimmzettel zu drucken und die Wähler darüber zu informieren, zu welchem Bezirk sie gehören. Das bedeutet, dass Gerichte oft unter Druck stehen, Streitigkeiten über Karten schnell zu klären, sobald eine Klage eingereicht wird.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: Sollte das Urteil Bestand haben, wären die Republikaner in der Position, die neuen Grenzen bei den Zwischenwahlen im Herbst zu nutzen – ein Schritt, der laut unabhängigen Analysten Cleavers Sitz für einen republikanischen Herausforderer wesentlich wettbewerbsfähiger machen würde.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: Es wird erwartet, dass Demokraten und verbündete Gruppen weiterhin rechtliche Schritte verfolgen, einschließlich einer möglichen Eilberufung, in der Hoffnung, die ältere Karte wiederherzustellen oder eine Volksabstimmung zu sichern, bevor die Stimmzettel finalisiert werden.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: Der Fall ist einer von mehreren anhängigen Rechtsstreiten landesweit über die Neugestaltung von Wahlkreisen mitten im Jahrzehnt, und sein Ausgang könnte beeinflussen, wie andere Staaten an ähnliche Kartenänderungen im Vorfeld der Wahlen 2026 herangehen.

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Một thẩm phán tòa án lưu động Quận Cole đã phán quyết rằng quy trình trưng cầu dân ý của công dân Missouri không thể được sử dụng để ngăn chặn bản đồ quốc hội mới được vẽ của tiểu bang, một quyết định loại bỏ rào cản pháp lý lớn đối với việc Đảng Cộng hòa vẽ lại ranh giới của một thành trì lâu năm của Đảng Dân chủ trước cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ vào tháng 11.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## Phán quyết nói gì

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: Theo hồ sơ tòa án, thẩm phán nhận thấy rằng luật tái phân chia khu vực bầu cử được cơ quan lập pháp do Đảng Cộng hòa kiểm soát thông qua đầu năm nay không đủ điều kiện là loại biện pháp có thể bị đình chỉ và đưa ra bỏ phiếu toàn tiểu bang theo quy trình trưng cầu dân ý của Missouri.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: Những người phản đối bản đồ đã thu thập chữ ký với hy vọng buộc phải tổ chức một cuộc bỏ phiếu công khai có thể đã trì hoãn hoặc lật ngược các ranh giới mới trước cuộc bầu cử năm nay.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: Với việc con đường trưng cầu dân ý hiện đã bị đóng lại, bản đồ được vẽ lại đã sẵn sàng để có hiệu lực cho chu kỳ bầu cử năm 2026, trừ khi một tòa án cấp cao hơn can thiệp.
